name: 21122 · Pasadena, MD
findings: ZIP 21122 (Pasadena) has 150 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21122 (Pasadena) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 15 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
